summary.text: Chuong Vo is the Republican candidate in California's 45th District. A retired Torrance Police Department officer, he served on the Cerritos City Council from 2020 to 2025 and describes himself as a former mayor of Cerritos. His campaign website lists public safety, affordability and accountability as his themes.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, he is married to Traci, a classroom teacher, and they have two children; he says he is grateful to "a country that gave my family a chance," like many immigrant families.
Worked as a law-enforcement officer with the Torrance Police Department from 1999 to 2025; his campaign website describes a 28-year law-enforcement career that included answering 911 calls.
Served on the Cerritos City Council from 2020 to 2025, according to Ballotpedia; his campaign website also calls him a former Mayor of Cerritos.
Served on the executive board of the California Joint Powers Insurance Authority, a risk-management pool, between 2021 and 2025.
Says he retired from law enforcement to spend more time with his family before deciding to run for Congress; advanced from the June 2, 2026 top-two primary to the general election.
